`DurableStore.restRequest` and `executeSql` used `AbortSignal.timeout(8000)`. Under live load, the Supabase durable-document read (used by owner AI chat) exceeded 8s and aborted before the LLM call could start, surfacing as the owner-facing "AI provider did not respond in time" error.

### Code Changed
- `backend/services/ivx-durable-store.ts`
  - Added `export const REST_TIMEOUT_MS = 30000`
  - Replaced both hardcoded `8000` abort signals in `executeSql` and `restRequest`
  - Bumped schema marker to `ivx-durable-store-2026-08-07`
- `backend/services/ivx-durable-store.test.ts` (new)
  - Regression guard: `REST_TIMEOUT_MS` must be `30000`
  - `durableKeyForFile` and `isDurableStoreConfigured` coverage
